entries.text: A meta-domain view, sensitive_coverage, lists every sensitive column of the org (any tag with the Sensitive data option, pii included), one row each, read through the same statement that decides a Test (fake) environment's uncovered columns (provisa.security.sensitive.sensitive_assignments): its tags; has_fake and has_synthetic_rule; the fake as declared, its kind, that it is deterministic, whether it is stable across engines and whether it is computed from the real value; the synthetic rule as declared; and a status of covered, no_fake or inadequate with the reason.
changes: sensitive_coverage meta view and fake adequacy checks
fake_adequacy_checks is classified, inventoried and in schema.sql

entries.text: A configuration may declare a replica's rows instead of landing them from its source: replica_rows/<source_id>/<schema>.<table>.tsv beside its config.yaml, its first line the table's columns in their order, tab separated, each line after one row (\N is NULL; \t, \n, \r and \\ a tab, newline, carriage return and backslash; an integer, floating or boolean column's cells read as that type, every other as its text).
changes: A config's declared replica rows land as its replica; its source is never read
A config's declared rows land in its model build, beside the config a test server serves
Declared rows land before the schema build publishes its replica routes

entries.text: The MCP server offers five statistics tools over a dataset the caller defines in SQL: describe (per column count, missing, distinct, mean, sd, quantiles and top values), correlate (pearson or spearman matrix and n), regress (linear: coefficients, standard errors, p-values, R²; logistic: the same with pseudo R² and AUC), compare (Welch's t-test for two groups, one-way ANOVA for more, with Cohen's d or eta squared) and forecast (exponential smoothing, ETS, with prediction intervals).
changes: describe, correlate, regress, compare and forecast over governed SQL
stats.forecast casts its ETS fit to its results, which pyright refused as a union

entries.text: Central redaction: one list of rules is applied to text before it leaves Provisa.
changes: Central redaction of spans, logs, audit text and client errors
Redaction rules -- one name column width, monospace values with plain labels
Redaction -- a bearer token is 16+ token characters; names resolve through the backend
Judgments under review -- why, bases, findings, the review and posture
Judgment review -- nullable JSON stores SQL NULL; exports compare without the server's stamps
A profiler member never run gives no evidence instead of failing the seed

entries.text: A named demo declares its secrets in secrets.yaml beside its config.yaml (secrets: a mapping of each name to its value), carried in its bundle with the rest of its directory.
changes: A demo seeds its secrets; testdata reads prod as Provisa's own secret

entries.text: Package registries reach a proxy such as Artifactory and the Git servers GitLab, Bitbucket Cloud and Bitbucket Data Center as well as GitHub.
changes: Package registries reach Artifactory, GitLab and Bitbucket, behind a private CA
